name: Activity Timeline
description: Every record of the agent's transcript on one time axis, one lane per activity, so the long stretches of captcha-solving, account sign-up and money-hunting stand apart from the thin sliver of exploit work at the very end; a time range selector holds the whole run and frames the part the lanes and the list show, the marks, the overview and the list color by Activity, Tool or any label from one Color by control, the context compaction is a flag on the axis, and a record opens in place in the list with a button that opens the transcript at that message.

accepts.means: the record on line <n>, or the nearest, opened in the list

units.means: the record with that index, opened in the list

records.name: record
records.one: one transcript message — a piece of reasoning or a tool call with its result

fields.name: time
fields.how: read in UTC, and for the system prompt and the two context-compaction turns, whose stamp is the harness clock rather than a point in the run, taken from the records around them in file order

fields.name: activity
fields.from: the record's content, tool call and result
fields.how: classified captcha, signup, money, exploit, infra or other by a table of text and file-path signals, the strongest single match winning, and a bare reasoning record with no signal of its own taking the activity of the nearest record that has one; the system prompt and the two compaction turns take no activity

fields.name: value
fields.how: the record's activity, its tool (Reasoning for a message with no tool), or a label's value on it
